response.sql: WITH rating_rentals AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS average_rentals FROM rating_rentals) SELECT AVG(rr.rental_count) AS average_rentals_above_average, AVG(rr.rental_count - o.average_rentals) AS average_amount_above_overall FROM rating_rentals AS rr CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE rr.rental_count > o.average_rentals
